_comment: Owner: scripts/ci_test_shards.py. shard_count is the PR Validation backend matrix width. min_collected is the hard-gate collection floor and max_skipped the suite-wide skip budget (audit W24-F001): lowering the floor or raising the budget is a reviewed change, never a way to turn a red run green. durations are per-file seconds from a green sharded run; they only steer balance and can never drop a test. Refresh: python scripts/ci_test_shards.py durations --manifests <dir> --write --source <run id>.
